# The lab's fact base

One structured file per matter, made from the matter's sources README (`research/<date>-<matter>/sources/README.md`), so that roadmaps, maps and, after Phase 1, the assistant read the same checked facts. It is a lab base: production's verified registry (`reference/`, formalka@04057ef) stays the only source of what the prototype shows, and nothing here is copied into production (ADR-N001).

**Index:** `knowledge/INDEX.md`, generated by `node tools/knowledge/index.mjs`.
**Check:** `node tools/knowledge/check.mjs` and `node --test tools/knowledge/*.test.mjs`. Both fail on any problem below.

## Rules

1. **Nothing from memory.** Every record comes from a row of the sources README, and every fact and page record quotes its source verbatim (product rule 1).
2. **A quote is checked by code:** it must occur in the cited file's body (not in its "#" header), allowing for line breaks and words broken with a hyphen. "…" may skip text between parts that occur in order. A quote holds at least 20 characters.
3. **Complete:** every fact row, page row, inference and OPEN id of the README has at least one record. A README in another format says `"coverage": false` and why.
4. **Status follows the check:** a matter is "checked" only when its folder holds `CHECK.md` from the separate checking agent; otherwise it is "unchecked", and nothing in it is relied on.
5. **Kinds stay apart:** a page statement is what an official page says (not binding); an inference is the lab's reading, with its basis; an open record is a question the sources do not settle. "Nie wiem" is the answer when no record covers a question (product rule 3).
6. **When the law changes,** the README and its extract change first; the record follows, and the check fails until it does.

## Format (`knowledge/facts/<matter>.json`)

```json
{
  "matter": "return-decision",
  "doc19": 26,
  "title": "A return decision or voluntary return (a handoff only)",
  "map": "docs/formalka-next/maps/return-decision.md",
  "readme": "research/2026-10-17-return/sources/README.md",
  "asOf": "2026-10-17",
  "check": { "status": "unchecked", "file": null },
  "acts": {
    "UoC": { "name": "the act on foreigners, consolidated", "eli": "DU/2025/1079", "note": "with Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1794 and Dz.U. 2026 poz. 203" }
  },
  "records": [
    {
      "id": "return-decision.appeal",
      "kind": "fact",
      "section": "The return decision",
      "topic": "The appeal",
      "claim": "The higher body is the Border Guard Commander-in-Chief; the appeal is filed within 7 days of the decision's delivery.",
      "basis": [{ "act": "UoC", "unit": "art. 321" }],
      "quotes": [{ "file": "research/2026-10-17-return/sources/uoc-return-extract.txt", "text": "Odwołanie od decyzji w sprawach, o których mowa w ust. 1, wnosi się w terminie 7 dni od dnia doręczenia decyzji." }]
    }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `matter` | The map's file name, without `.md`; the file's own name |
| `doc19` | The matter's number in doc 19, or null |
| `check` | `{"status": "checked", "file": "<folder>/CHECK.md"}` or `{"status": "unchecked", "file": null}` |
| `acts` | The abbreviations the README cites, each with `eli` (DU/<year>/<position>), `celex` or `url` |
| `records[].id` | `<matter>.<words-with-hyphens>`, unique in the whole base |
| `records[].kind` | `fact` (a README "What they say" row), `page` (a "What the pages add" or "Where the pages differ" row), `inference`, `open` |
| `records[].section`, `topic` | The README's "###" heading and the row's first cell, as plain text (facts); the row's first cell, the bullet's bold lead, or the OPEN id (others) |
| `records[].claim` | The README row's content in English, adding nothing to it |
| `records[].comparison` | For a page record: what the act says against the page (the README's "Act" column) |
| `records[].basis` | `[{ "act": "<key in acts, or PAGES>", "unit": "art. 321 ust. 2" }]` |
| `records[].quotes` | `[{ "file": "<path from the repository root>", "text": "<verbatim>" }]` |
| `records[].from`, `until` | When the rule applies from or until a date (YYYY-MM-DD), as the source states it |
